adultDescription: Old and brown and knuckled, mended in a hundred places, still going wherever the water went.
babyDescription: A pale thread under a stone, already leaning towards the wet side of it.
description: Wickroot does not choose where to go - the damp chooses, and Wickroot agrees with enormous enthusiasm. It has crossed a car park, lifted two flagstones and turned up in a cellar nobody had opened in forty years, and it was delighted by all three. Show it a dry map and it will find the one wet corner you did not know you had, then tell you about it by coming up through the floor.
name: Wickroot
teenDescription: Has crossed the path. Cannot be pulled up, and would rather you kept trying.
